authority: Owner exact read-only Screenshot/screenshotEnabled flag and known capture-directory/filename metadata request; no other config output, writes or new capture attempt
targetScript:
set -eu
# Return ONLY the exact stock capture capability key; no other settings or values.
flag_found=0
if test -f /home/root/.config/remarkable/xochitl.conf && test ! -L /home/root/.config/remarkable/xochitl.conf; then
 while IFS= read -r line || test -n "$line"; do
  case "$line" in
   Screenshot=*|screenshotEnabled=*)
    key=${line%%=*};value=${line#*=};flag_found=1
    case "$value" in true|false|1|0) printf 'CAPTURE_CAPABILITY %s=%s\n' "$key" "$value" ;; *) printf 'CAPTURE_CAPABILITY %s=NONBOOLEAN_PRESENT\n' "$key" ;; esac
    ;;
  esac
 done < /home/root/.config/remarkable/xochitl.conf
 if test "$flag_found" = 0; then printf '%s\n' 'CAPTURE_CAPABILITY Exact Screenshot/screenshotEnabled keys ABSENT'; fi
else printf '%s\n' 'CAPTURE_CAPABILITY stock settings file absent or symlink; no fallback'; fi
for directory in /home/root/screenshots /home/root/Screenshots /tmp/screenshots; do
 if test -d "$directory" && test ! -L "$directory"; then stat -c 'KNOWN_CAPTURE_DIRECTORY %n %F %a %u %g %Y' "$directory"; else printf 'KNOWN_CAPTURE_DIRECTORY_ABSENT %s\n' "$directory"; fi
done
for image in /home/root/screenshot.png /home/root/Screenshot.png /home/root/screenshots/screenshot.png /home/root/Screenshots/screenshot.png; do
 if test -f "$image" && test ! -L "$image"; then stat -c 'EXPECTED_CAPTURE_FILE %n %Y %s' "$image"; fi
done
stdout:
CAPTURE_CAPABILITY Exact Screenshot/screenshotEnabled keys ABSENT
KNOWN_CAPTURE_DIRECTORY_ABSENT /home/root/screenshots
KNOWN_CAPTURE_DIRECTORY_ABSENT /home/root/Screenshots
KNOWN_CAPTURE_DIRECTORY_ABSENT /tmp/screenshots
